searchText: we should just use hive for this? is there a reason why that won't work? Doesn't seem like we need to an army of people to play a game, we just need to get one person to configure and run https://github.com/ethereum/hive or this if people think that would be easier: https://github.com/makerdao/testchain I appreciate that people are running the vulcanize fork for testing, but just configuring hive and running it for 2 hours would have probably answered a lot of these questions. If hive is missing the inspection tools required to use it in this case, then maybe file an issue against that? From telegram ( my previous points ) https://temporals.herokuapp.com/time_series/13/safeLow Safe Low gas price is volatile = it means that for many people their UX looks like this: - create transaction - check ETH gas station for safe low gas price - decide if they want fast or slow confirmation time ( mental math ) \ then adding epsilon to safe low price ( tricky and hard to do in metamask ) And if user would use too much gas fee ( interface actually allows for such errors ) then he will feel cheated TBH electrum has solved fees better as there is slider that doesn't even allow for gas_fee equivalent to be higher than what's required to put it in first block

excerpts.content:
From telegram ( my previous points )
https://temporals.herokuapp.com/time_series/13/safeLow

Safe Low gas price is volatile = it means that for many people their UX looks like this:
- create transaction 
- check ETH gas station for safe low gas price 
- decide if they want fast or slow confirmation time ( mental math ) \
then adding epsilon to safe low price ( tricky and hard to do in metamask )
And if user would use too much gas fee ( interface actually allows for such errors ) then he will feel cheated

TBH electrum has solved fees better as there is slider that doesn't even allow for gas_fee equivalent to be higher than what's required to put it in first block
